tools.description: Measure what a folder really loads, in tokens, by asking Claude Code itself: one request per variant, which spends model tokens and is cached per Claude Code version, model and settings. params.description: The folder where Claude Code starts
params.name: cwd

params.description: The folder where Claude Code starts
params.name: cwd

tools.description: List the tasks (named, repeatable jobs of steps) with their triggers, last run, next scheduled run and whether a run waits for the person. Disabled drafts only with all
tools.name: tasks_list

tools.description: Show one task's definition (steps, the secrets it may write, the servers and commands it needs, triggers) and its last five runs. Secret values are never part of it
tools.name: tasks_get

tools.description: List the runs of a task, newest first, or one run with its step logs (already redacted) when run is given
tools.name: tasks_history

params.description: Only the runs of this task
params.name: id

params.description: One run id: returns that run with the log of every step
params.name: run

tools.description: Start a task. The person is asked to approve every run through the approval broker; a denial, a timeout or a missing broker starts nothing. The result is the run record (steps and statuses); a task with a step that needs the person pauses as waiting until they resume it. Pass dry_run to see the steps, the secrets it may write and the servers it needs, without asking and without starting
tools.name: tasks_run

tools.description: Cancel a running or waiting task run and stop its child process
tools.name: tasks_cancel

params.description: The run id (from tasks_list, tasks_get or tasks_history)
params.name: run

tools.description: List the installed Claude Code plugins with what each brings (skills, agents, commands, hooks, MCP servers), whether it is on in the folder, its token cost and its MCP servers that sit outside the gateway
tools.name: plugins_ls

params.description: Folder where Claude Code starts; its project and local settings decide which plugins are on
params.name: cwd

params.description: Run claude plugin marketplace update first
params.name: refresh

tools.description: Show one installed plugin: components, hooks, MCP servers with their deny state, options and token cost. Option values marked sensitive are never returned
tools.name: plugins_show

params.description: Plugin id such as ecc@ecc, or a bare plugin name when it is unique
params.name: id

params.description: Folder where Claude Code starts; its project and local settings decide whether the plugin is on and its MCP servers denied
params.name: cwd

tools.description: Set or unset a plugin's own switches (its adapter's knobs). With cwd they become env keys in that folder's git-ignored .claude/settings.local.json, ledgered so undo restores only what Toolport wrote; without cwd only knobs that are plugin options are set, through claude plugin configure. A switched-off hook still starts a process; only turning the plugin off removes it. dry_run is on by default: pass dry_run=false to apply
tools.name: plugins_config

params.description: Plugin id such as ecc@ecc, or a bare plugin name when it is unique
params.name: id

params.description: Folder where Claude Code starts; omit to set plugin options globally
params.name: cwd

params.description: Knobs to set, as {knob: value}; a value is a string, a boolean or a list of strings
params.name: set

params.description: Knobs whose Toolport-written value is removed
params.name: unset

params.description: Report without writing; true unless you pass false to apply
params.name: dry_run

tools.description: Deny or allow one MCP server of a plugin in a folder: deny writes {serverName: plugin:<plugin>:<server>} into deniedMcpServers of the folder's git-ignored .claude/settings.local.json, allow removes only that entry. The server stays outside the gateway. dry_run is on by default: pass dry_run=false to apply
tools.name: plugins_mcp

params.description: Plugin id such as ecc@ecc, or a bare plugin name when it is unique
params.name: id

params.description: The plugin's MCP server name (see plugins_show)
params.name: server

params.description: Folder where Claude Code starts; nothing is written above it

params.name: dry_run
